# Bug report

## Version and runtime

State the Mirrorling version, Node.js version and whether the defect occurs in the local Node runtime, Netlify or both.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest safe configuration and request path that demonstrate the problem. Replace real hostnames, credentials and customer data.

## Expected production behaviour

Describe what the unmodified production page or request does.

## Observed staging behaviour

Describe the difference, including the selected scenario and whether the failure concerns an element override, injection, script override, route mock or handover.

## Evidence

Include relevant logs, response headers or a sanitised Playwright trace. Never post secrets publicly.
